description: Paid. Calculates employer Class 1 National Insurance for one or more annual salaries on a date using verified UK Rules data. Use this instead of doing the maths yourself. Paid: $0.005 USD per call via x402, or use an API key (see /pricing).

apply_employment_allowance.description: Default false. If true, also returns the Employment Allowance in force and the net total

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today in Europe/London

label.description: Optional name or reference for the employee, echoed back

name: calculate_employer_ni
